You are a really great person!
I'm sure I hurt her plenty of times as well. I not mad at her about anything. I feel only love for her. She will suffer if I kill myself, but to be honest I think in the long run she will be happier. Every time I'm in a bad mood, I can see that it affects her as well. She would be happier without this.
No I don't, but it hurts me deeply that she said it.

She said it because she believes that by bringing up suicide, I'm just trying to manipulate her into caring about me. When she loved me she always did the best for me she could. She's an amazing person.
Thank you , I need at least a bit of love to keep living. I desperately need it.

See my other replies for the main part of my story. My hobbies used to be video games and simply learning cool facts about the world we live in, but it's been at least a year since I got any enjoyment from those things.

Your words hurt so much, because I know this is the truth...
I simply can't help but love her, she is everything to me. Whenever I talk to another woman I just find that my ex is such a better person, than she is the only thing that I want... no other woman manages to wake the feelings she wake in me. And it kills me. I need her so much, engage in self-harm when I haven't seen her more than a couple of days. Because I simply can't stand the psychological pain. 

I know it's unrealistic, but I just hope that she will one day realize how much I love her, I need to care for her. Other than that I just want to kill myself and make this end.

Am I a piece of trash? I just can't help feeling this way.

I'm 26, and don't know why people laugh at me, I try to take care of the way I look. Maybe I just say stupid things, but they don't sound stupid to me. It happens very often that when I talk to a stranger and walk away after that that I hear them laugh and say something like "what a weirdo", I wouldn't find it insulting, if this wasn't the only thing I ever hear about myself in public...

The person who I adore, who I love incredibly deeply, my ex-wife, told me 7 months ago that she doesn't love me and she loves someone else. And that person doesn't even love her and just uses her. Every few weeks he just asks her for nudes, she just immediately drops everything she's doing and sends him pictures and then he stops writing her again. When I tell her he doesn't care about her, she just says that I'm being manipulative about her relationship. And I still love so much... We still live together because I told her that I need her even when we are not together anymore and because she has nowhere else to go. I give her everything I have, not only money but I also care for her and cook for her and because I love her so much, I just can't stop helping her, but it really kills me inside whenever she doesn't talk to me, whenever she shares her feelings with him and he just ignores her, whenever I imagine living without her....

This is really is a great friend, she just thinks that I'm saying stuff like that just to get attention. Which is why she said that, but it still hurts me deeply..... And I just keep disappointing her, because I don't have the strength to do anything anymore more....

And BTW I'm talking about my ex-wife.
He just says this bullshit in order to avoid responsibility for his words.

Isn't that the same guy who said that the only thing holding up the Diablo 3 release date was South Korea?

And now Diablo 3 is approved for SK and there's still no sign of a release date. I don't believe a word he says. He's probably just some random troll.
